observations.code_quote:
"description": "Turn a feature flag on. Requires the flag's numeric ID; use `feature-flag-get-definition-by-key` to get it from a key, or `feature-flag-get-all` to search by key or name.

Sets `active` to true and changes nothing else. This tool never accepts or replaces the `filters` object, so targeting, rollout percentages, variants and payloads cannot change. There is no request body. To change who the flag is served to, use `update-feature-flag`.

Returns 400 when the flag is archived (call `feature-flag-unarchive` first), when a flag it depends on is disabled, or when a release condition targets a deleted cohort (remove that condition with `update-feature-flag`). Returns 409 when an approval policy gates enabling. Enabling an already-enabled flag succeeds and changes nothing, so retrying is safe.

`feature-flag-get-definition-by-key` also finds archived flags. `feature-flag-get-all` hides archived flags unless you pass `{"archived":"true"}`.

To turn the flag on at a future time instead, use `scheduled-changes-create` with the `update_status` operation.",
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a documented rejection case for the feature-flag-enable tool when a release condition targets a deleted cohort, and points users to update-feature-flag to remove that condition.

observations.behavior: Documentation and schema updates: P1.F17.H2 and P1.F18.H2 add a release-condition-deleted-cohort rejection case to the description of the feature-flag-unarchive tool.
observations.code_quote:
"description": "Restore an archived feature flag to the default flag list. Requires the flag's numeric ID; pass `{"archived":"true"}` to `feature-flag-get-all` to find archived flags.

Sets `archived` to false and changes nothing else. This tool never accepts or replaces the `filters` object. There is no request body.

The flag stays turned off. Call `feature-flag-enable` when the user also wants it serving again. Unarchiving a flag that is not archived succeeds and changes nothing, so retrying is safe.

Returns 400 when a release condition targets a deleted cohort. Remove that condition with `update-feature-flag` first.",
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a documented rejection case for the feature-flag-unarchive tool when a release condition targets a deleted cohort, and points users to update-feature-flag to remove that condition.
